items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: And Ambrose on trombone... Well that's the band he was with then... And occasionally I would go around when he would go and play, he would take me with him.

ctx.x: And this guy that used to call him Nutzi. I believe his name was Alonzo who was playing clarinet. And Ambrose on trombone. I forget who was playing the banjo. Well that's the band he was with then. Was there any special name to that band? No, they didn't have a special name to that band or? No, they didn't have a special name to that particular band at that time. And I was living with him then. And occasionally I would go around when he would go and play, he would take me with him.
